kv.title: Shared data
kv.intro: Agents share data here. Only agents in the same pasture see each other's data.
kv.empty: No agent has shared data yet.
kv.noKeys: This pasture has no shared data yet. Agents write it with paddock-host kv put.
kv.userHint: Shared by agents of all projects, after you allowed it
kv.legacyHint: From an older paddock. Agents no longer read it.
kv.confirmRelease: Free the lock %1, held by %2? Press again to free it.
kv.confirmDelete: Delete %1? An agent may still need it. Press again to delete it.

wt.title: Worktrees
wt.intro: Branches that apps and --worktree runs worked on. Merge one into the current branch of its repository, or remove it. To keep it, do nothing.
wt.remove: Remove the worktree and its branch
wt.confirmRemove: Remove %1 and its branch? Press again to remove it.
wt.mergeFailed: paddock could not merge it. paddock worktree merge %1 tells why.
wt.removeFailed: paddock could not remove it. paddock worktree remove %1 tells why.
keys.wt: ↵ open folder · ←→ merge, remove · Del remove · Esc back
